rationale: The controller needs an explicit renewal cadence for its exclusive, renewable ownership. This is an immutable controller-policy input, distinct from stale_after_seconds, which defines when missed heartbeats become stale.
alternatives: derive from stale_after_seconds, but that would hide an operational policy choice
remove, but the controller would lack a declared ownership-renewal cadence
simplestChoice: Keep heartbeat_seconds as the controller ownership-renewal interval.
